title: Sprintlet Session Memo — Mini Experiment Tracker
content:
Sprintlet session notes (quick personal tracker) — 2026-02-17

Purpose:
- Short runs to capture interaction between KV prefix caching and batching at small seq lengths. Trying to validate that enabling prefix cache + moderate batching (B=4) reduces token cost without adding tail latency for spot workloads.
- Keep this as a compact reference to paste into ticket/PR.

Session metadata:
- Session ID: sprintlet-20260217-sage-1
- Seed prompts: 30 customer-like prompts (short queries, avg 12 tokens seed).
- Model variants: open-gpt-13B (fp16), q4_0 and q2_K (quant profiles in Optimize).
- HW: g5dn.12xlarge (single GPU per worker), dedicated test pool on dev account.
- Runtime flags: --prefill-cache=true/false; --batch-size=1/2/4; continuous-batching enabled.

Compact run table (note: avg_latency_ms measured from request->first-token and p95 is end-to-end):
| run | date | model | quant | batch | cache | avg_latency_ms | p95_ms | tokens_out | notes |
|-----|------|-------|-------|-------|-------|----------------|-------|------------|-------|
| R1  | 2026-02-17 | open-gpt-13B | fp16  | 1 | off  | 142  | 320 | 18 | baseline, no cache, cold KV |
| R2  | 2026-02-17 | open-gpt-13B | fp16  | 4 | off  | 165  | 360 | 17 | batching adds tail latency but better throughput |
| R3  | 2026-02-17 | open-gpt-13B | fp16  | 1 | on   | 95   | 180 | 18 | prefix cache hit -> big latency win |
| R4  | 2026-02-17 | open-gpt-13B | q4_0  | 4 | on   | 108  | 220 | 17 | quant + cache: good median, p95 ok |
| R5  | 2026-02-17 | open-gpt-13B | q2_K  | 4 | on   | 102  | 300 | 16 | q2_K reduces cost but p95 regressed (IO?) |
| R6  | 2026-02-17 | open-gpt-13B | q2_K  | 1 | on   | 85   | 150 | 16 | single batch + q2_K + cache best median, low p95

Quick observations (raw, for ticket):
- Enabling prefix KV cache consistently reduces median latency by ~30-45% for short prompts (compare R1->R3 and R2->R4).
- Batching (B=4) helps throughput but tends to increase p95; for small-seq, single-request latency is most important for product use-cases.
- q2_K quant profile lowers median slightly vs fp16 but showed higher p95 in one config (R5) — possibly read amplification when decompressing kernels on smaller GPU memory. Need profiling on kernel launch times.
- Best per-request experience for interactive product: q2_K or fp16 + cache + batch=1 (R6/R3). For throughput-sensitive offline jobs, batch=4 + cache + q4_0 looks cost-effective (R4).

ToDos / follow-ups:
- [ ] Add micro-trace (profile) for R5 to capture kernel launch and GPU memcpy times (attach nvprof logs) — assign Devon.
- [ ] Re-run R4/R5 with --cpu-prefetch=on to see if p95 improves (small change, low-risk).
- [ ] Update INF-1423 with a short summary (copy paste observations) and propose fallback policy: prefer cached variant for interactive routes, fallback to batched quant variant under high QPS.
- [ ] Add these sample runs to the per-route PerfBench artifacts (console route: /routes/quick-chat) as a quick reference.

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep this terse — this doc is my scratchpad to drop into PR description.
- Remember: observed p95 regressions sometimes correlate with node GC or collector load; check node / container restarts during R5.
- Slack thread: #runtime-bench (see thread ts: 2026-02-17T11:02) — ping Maya for kernel timing capture.

Unresolved questions:
- Why does q2_K show worse p95 only with batch=4 (R5) but not batch=1 (R6)? Hypothesis: batch coalescing + quant dequant path causes extra memcpy. Need micro-bench.
- Is continuous-batching interaction with prefix cache causing stale cache evictions at high QPS? Quick sim needed.

One-line summary to paste in PR/issue:
"Prefix KV cache gives the biggest interactive win (30–45% median cut). For interactive routes, use cache + minimal batching; for throughput tasks prefer cached + moderate batching with q4_0 quant profile as a lower-cost compromise. Need kernel-level profiling for q2_K to investigate occasional p95 regressions."

Scratch checklist (for PR):
- [ ] attach this sprintlet log
- [ ] upload nvprof trace if Devon gets it
- [ ] link PR to INF-1423 and the confluence proposal

End of sprintlet. Short, messy, usable.

-- Sage
